en.title: Shortest Paths to Multiple Targets
en.description:
On a directed graph with non-negative weights, find the shortest paths from source to multiple targets; unreachable targets are -1.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: n≤200000, m≤300000, w≤10^9; nodes are 1-based, and the input is n m source q, then the edges, then the targets.
en.output: Output the target distances in order.
en.explanation: Run Dijkstra from source and return the distances per query.
hints: Run Dijkstra from source and return the distances per query.
